propositions: The deprecated environment variable REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be removed from the resolver, with a tombstone registry entry that raises RemovedInputError at runtime to fail loud rather than silently ignore a still-set value
The config key [tool.rebar.llm].model and per-class REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_MODEL environment variables remain active; only the bare env channel is removed
All test files that set REBAR_LLM_MODEL and instantiate LLMConfig must be retargeted to use surviving resolution paths: the config table, per-class env vars, or CLI overrides
Documentation and operator-facing material must be updated to reflect removal rather than deprecation status across 10+ hand-written docs and infra files
The model resolution precedence shifts from CLI > env > config > default to CLI > config > default for the bare model, while per-class env slots keep their position in their own precedence chain
